email.subject: Large, deep water-filled pothole in the roadway near Baltimore Avenue, College Park
email.body:
Hello District 3 (Laurel Maintenance Shop) / Office of Maintenance,

I'm writing to report a problem that needs repair: Large, deep water-filled pothole in the roadway.

A large, deep, water-filled pothole in the asphalt/concrete roadway surface. It has been growing for 2 weeks and popped a tire.

Location: Baltimore Avenue, College Park
Exact spot: Northbound right lane in front of the 7-Eleven

I've attached a photo (photo.jpg).

Could you please arrange a repair, or let me know if this should go to a different office?

Thank you,

ISSUE_KIND: pothole
ISSUE: Pothole in the northbound right lane of Baltimore Avenue (US 1)
DETAILS: A large, deep, water-filled pothole in the asphalt/concrete roadway surface. The user note states it is in the northbound right lane in front of the 7-Eleven, has been growing for 2 weeks, and popped their tire yesterday.
ORGANIZATION: Maryland Department of Transportation State Highway Administration (MDOT SHA)
DEPARTMENT: District 3 (Laurel Maintenance Shop) / Office of Maintenance
WHY: Although this spot is inside the incorporated City of College Park, Baltimore Avenue is US Route 1, a state-maintained highway rather than a city street. The City of College Park explicitly lists Baltimore Avenue/Route 1 as maintained by the State Highway Administration (SHA), and MDOT SHA District 3 oversees Prince George's County via its Laurel Maintenance Shop.
